item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 07 November 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #NegrosOccidental, #NegrosOriental, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 19 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 19 #VISPRSD
Issued at 09:50 PM 07 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Leyte(Macarthur, Mayorga, LaPaz), #EasternSamar(Balangiga, Lawaan), #SouthernLeyte(Silago, Hinunangan and Hinundayan) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Leyte(Mahaplag, Abuyog, CityOfBaybay, Javier), #EasternSamar(Hernani, GeneralMacarthur, Llorente, Quinapondan, Giporlos) and #OccidentalMindoro(Magsaysay) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 18 #VISPRSD

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
